actions.name: Overwatch
actions.description: Effect: The user sets a 30-degree Overwatch Cone, size of 15m. Until the user's next Activation, creatures in the Overwatch Cone are considered to be within the user's Reach for the purposes of Attack of Opportunity, and the user may declare Attacks of Opportunity against those creatures using non-@Trait[contact] Attacks.

system.description: Effect: By spending @PP[-3] as a @Trait[flinch-40] Complex Action, the user may set a 30-degree Overwatch Cone, size of 15m. Until the user's next Activation, creatures in the Overwatch Cone are considered to be within the user's Reach for the purposes of Attack of Opportunity, and the user may declare Attacks of Opportunity against those creatures using non-@Trait[contact] Attacks.
